name: Heap
description: Heap is a digital insights platform for autocaptured product analytics, Events, users, sessions, Pageviews, Segments, Journeys, Session Replay, dashboards, and behavioral analysis.
agentUseSummary: Heap cannot currently be connected as a native Relay agent provider because Heap publishes no self-service customer-account analytics read API or delegated OAuth contract. Its public APIs ingest data or perform account-wide user deletion, while analytics querying requires a separately licensed Heap Connect warehouse and its Segments Sync integration requires a provider relationship.

blocked.label: Connect a Heap account
blocked.description: Heap does not publish a supported self-service customer-account OAuth or native analytics-read credential contract for public third-party applications.

blocked.label: Read Heap analytics
blocked.description: Heap publishes no bounded native API for reading account analytics, charts, dashboards, Events, users, sessions, Pageviews, or aggregate reports.

blocked.label: Ingest Heap data
blocked.description: Client- and server-side tracking, identity, and property APIs write customer data into Heap and must not be represented as analytics reads.

blocked.label: Delete Heap users
blocked.description: Heap's authenticated User Deletion API performs destructive account-wide deletion across environments and is excluded from this Marketplace provider.

blocked.label: Bypass Heap through external data access
blocked.description: Relay will not invent warehouse credentials, query customer Heap Connect data, or receive Segments Sync data without separately approved authority, schemas, privacy controls, and a supported provider relationship.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported customer-account analytics read contract or a separately approved Heap Connect or partner integration model.

runtimeSupport.description: No supported native Heap analytics read contract is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No supported native Heap analytics read contract is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Heap's published APIs are ingestion-oriented or destructive User Deletion; analytics reads require customer Heap Connect warehouse access, and Segments Sync requires a separately established Heap provider relationship rather than a self-service public account API.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Heap credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Heap only after it publishes a distributable customer-account analytics read/OAuth contract, or after Relay separately approves a warehouse or provider-partner model with explicit authority, schema, privacy, and operational controls.

evidence.supports: Heap documents its authenticated public API key flow for destructive User Deletion across all account environments, not analytics reads.
Heap documents client-side APIs for sending Events and properties and managing identity, with server-side equivalents for ingestion.
Heap's server-side Track endpoint writes custom Events into a specified environment and does not expose analytics reads.
Heap directs direct analytics querying and custom analysis to separately configured Heap Connect destinations such as BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, and S3.
Heap's Segments Sync partner integration requires a Heap Partner Manager, Developers Hub access, a Heap test account, customer beta coordination, and an outbound webhook/OAuth implementation.
